data.why: The 'Your data' page accepts an uploaded PPI edge list (protein_a, protein_b, score, source) or compound-target table (compound, target, value, units, reference), matching proteinviz.datasets.schema.KINDS; the repo offers only an inline download button, not a file, so sample uploads were written to match the validator, including a missing value and an unverified/self-interaction edge case.

goals: Starting from a disease of interest, find its top associated protein targets, shared pathways, and known drug candidates (e.g. Alzheimer disease, MONDO_0004975)
Given a candidate protein pair, inspect their STRING interaction evidence and functional/physical network neighbourhood
Look up a protein's function, domains, sequence properties and disease associations from UniProt and Open Targets
For a chosen protein pair, find experimentally solved complexes in the PDB and compute the real interface residues between chains in a 3D viewer
Compare an AlphaFold model's per-residue confidence (pLDDT) and predicted aligned error (PAE) for a protein of interest
Upload or paste a custom gene list or interaction table and run the same pathway enrichment analysis on it

review.summary: The tree follows the README's disease → targets/pathways/network/drugs → pair structure path closely, includes the EGCG and Your data side routes, and every screen I sampled supports its node. Before filing it needs small corrections: the data-source label, the optional Network phase, and the missing permalink, provenance and protein-card coverage and features.
